title: TrekCraft Towny
description: TrekCraft is a friendly, long-standing PvE Towny server with an old-fashioned semi-vanilla feel, but plugins that add conveniences and more to do!  We have a fantastic community and helpful staff.
body:
## TrekCraft is not an ordinary server. 
Here at TC we have a **friendly community** that takes part in events every week and staff that will help you through any situation.

On TrekCraft you'll feel like you are part of the family, and that's exactly what we want. We've been around since 2014, so **you can trust us to last**! We reset for 1.18 and expand our map for all terrain updates, so there's plenty of fresh territory. When we do update, notable and requested builds are moved to a memory world so you can still visit them.

### Game-enhancing plugins:
- **Towny** 
- **McMMO**
- Mythic Mobs with **great custom bosses**
- ArtMap for creating custom artworks
- **Jobs**
- chest shops, player gui shops and auctions
- crates for voting and prizes
- quests
- **treasure hunts**
and much more, all with thoughtfully balanced configurations, helping
you have the best experience, whether it's having fun with friends, working hard to level skills, making amazing art, fighting mobs, or trying to build the best town!

### Events
Our staff also hosts **events** including:
- trivia (items obtained legitimately)
- drop parties (items obtained legitimately)
- **weekly activity contests** (most of something harvested or done)
- **build and art competitions**! 

### Rules
We're **family friendly**, so keep the chat appropriate for children: no swearing or discussion of inappropriate behavior allowed.

We're a **no raiding, no griefing** server. We rarely have a problem, but in the event of grief, our staff will happily roll it back for you. We allow pvp in arenas and towns that choose it, but almost all our pvp is friendly and agreed upon, and our resource worlds have pvp disabled. Almost all towns have pvp turned off within their borders, and we've got a great friendly community that will gladly help new players get started or old ones find what they need. :)

You can see our full rules at: https://trekcraft.guildtag.com/wiki/server-rules/ or at /warp rules once you're on the server.

### EULA Compliant
We are **fully EULA compliant**: our great ranks are obtained through in-game events, contests, treasure hunts and voting.
